title: Accessor
description: Descriptor of a finite non-empty sequence of typed values usually sourced from a buffer view.

bufferView.title: Buffer View
bufferView.description: The index of the buffer view. When undefined, elements are sourced from an infinite sequence of zero bytes or provided by an extension.

byteOffset.description: The offset into the buffer view in bytes.

componentType.description: The data type of the accessor's components.

anyOf.title: SINT8 or SNORM8
anyOf.description: 8-bit signed integer (sint8) or 8-bit signed normalized integer (snorm8).

anyOf.title: UINT8 or UNORM8
anyOf.description: 8-bit unsigned integer (uint8) or 8-bit unsigned normalized integer (unorm8).

anyOf.title: SINT16 or SNORM16
anyOf.description: 16-bit signed integer (sint16) or 16-bit signed normalized integer (snorm16).

anyOf.title: UINT16 or UNORM16
anyOf.description: 16-bit unsigned integer (uint16) or 16-bit unsigned normalized integer (unorm16).

anyOf.title: FLOAT32
anyOf.description: 32-bit floating-point number (float32) in IEEE 754 single-precision format (binary32).

anyOf.title: FLOAT64
anyOf.description: 64-bit floating-point number (float64) in IEEE 754 double-precision format (binary64).

anyOf.title: FLOAT16
anyOf.description: 16-bit floating-point number (float16) in IEEE 754 half-precision format (binary16).

count.description: The number of elements provided by the accessor.

max.description: Maximum value of each component as provided by the accessor. Array length corresponds to the accessor's type.

min.description: Minimum value of each component as provided by the accessor. Array length corresponds to the accessor's type.

normalized.description: Specifies whether integer values are normalized (divided by the component type's maximum possible value) before usage.

type.description: The dimensionality of the accessor elements.
